_comment: Nominal whoop and plate parameters shared by the simulator (sim/) and the identification tests (sysid/). Assumptions until the drone is weighed and identified: a 75 mm whoop of about 30 g (BetaFPV Meteor75 Pro class), L2F conventions (body x forward, y left, z up; thrust along +z; normalized motor command u in [0, 1]).

whoop._thrust: thrust per rotor [N] = c0 + c1 u + c2 u^2: about 0.3 N per rotor at full command, thrust-to-weight about 4 [assumption]
whoop._torque: yaw torque per rotor [N m] = rotor_torque_constant x thrust [assumption, Crazyflie order of magnitude]
whoop._time_constants: first-order lag of the normalized motor state u, rising constant when the command is above the state, falling otherwise, as L2F (70_post_integration.h); thrust follows from the lagged u [s] [assumption]
whoop._J: inertia [kg m^2], diagonal [assumption, scaled from the Crazyflie]
whoop._body_drag: linear drag of the bare whoop at the centre of mass, no torque: F = -diag(d) v_rel, v_rel the velocity relative to the air in the body frame [kg/s]; the truth of the synthetic flights in sysid/model.py (8 % of the weight at 3 m/s horizontally, less along z where the ducts are open) [assumption]
whoop._rotor_radius: propeller radius [m], 40 mm propellers; only used by the crude downwash term on the plate (plate.downwash_factor > 0) [assumption]

plate._comment: Vertical 3 mm EPP sheet under the frame, in the body x-z plane; model of research/flat_plate_aero.md section 1.5, Model B (saturating normal force) plus in-plane friction
plate._geometry: flat rectangle: unit normal n, edge chord_x along the in-plane unit vector chord_direction e_1, edge height_z along e_1 x n (docs/plate_model.md); vertical plate: n = y, e_1 = x, e_1 x n = z; Kp_x and Kp_z are the slopes for the in-plane wind along e_1 and e_1 x n
plate._added_mass: mass of the plate itself [kg]; with the plate the vehicle weighs mass + added_mass and the plate inertia is added to J
plate._downwash_factor: k_w: k_w times the rotors' induced velocity (momentum theory) added along body z to the plate's velocity relative to the air; 0 = no downwash

randomization._comment: domain randomization of the aerodynamics in training, drawn once per episode: each coefficient is multiplied by its own factor from U(1 - r, 1 + r). plate: C_N90, K_px, K_pz, C_T and e0; body_drag: each of the three components [assumption: the coefficients are only priors until the plate is identified]
